comment: The single source of truth for which Grafana dashboards exist and who owns them.
publish.sh, gen_dashboards.py and the README all read this file. Add a dashboard
here and nowhere else. gen_dashboards.py reports anything that drifts from this
list — unregistered, missing, wrong folder, or managed without a tabbed layout.
Each entry records its folder and tags.
managed   generated from this repo and published by publish.sh
keep      live and useful, deliberately not generated here; decided, not pending
archive   kept for reference, not maintained, not deleted; decided, not pending
stock     provisioned by Grafana Cloud or an integration; leave alone

dashboards.title: SOMA Engineering
dashboards.note: HTTP, routes, dependencies, workflow spans, database load, telemetry pipeline.

dashboards.title: SOMA Storage Observability
dashboards.note: Provider-attempt health, traffic, latency, retries, safe failure logs, and traces for Soma's storage boundaries. Ratios are attempts, not unique workflows.

dashboards.title: SOMA Angie Observability
dashboards.note: Terminal callback health, session and callback processing, Angie transcript storage, summary lookup work, safe failure logs, and traces. Provider-attempt ratios are diagnostic, not business SLIs.

dashboards.title: SOMA Angie — Claude Pool Status
dashboards.note: Per-account Claude 5-hour and 7-day usage/reset windows, scheduling eligibility, active/max capacity, cooldowns, sessions, API status, worker heartbeats, and runtime failures.

dashboards.title: SOMA Angie — Queue Health
dashboards.note: Queue depth, oldest wait, arrival and drain rates, and the drain plan needed to clear a backlog. Built in the UI and deliberately not generated here.

dashboards.title: SOMA Operations
dashboards.note: Webhook receipt and processing. Single page on purpose: an operator dashboard should hide nothing behind a tab.

dashboards.title: SOMA Workflow Health
dashboards.note: One tab per business workflow, overview first. Adding a workflow adds 8 panels automatically.

dashboards.title: Supabase — Soma (corrected)
dashboards.note: Curated USE coverage of Postgres and poolers, far better than the 127-panel stock integration board. Decision 2026-07-30: keep as is for now, not generated from this repo. Bring it in only when it next needs changing.

dashboards.title: Soma APM
dashboards.note: Proof of concept, 5 panels. Decision 2026-07-30: keep, archived.

dashboards.title: Soma Metrics
dashboards.note: Superseded by soma-engineering. Its business tiles (Tivly leads, Quotes submitted, Submission flows) render 0 in green, which reads as healthy when the truth is not-measured — so do not use it for business questions. Decision 2026-07-30: keep, archived rather than deleted.

dashboards.title: Soma OTel - Local Test Proof
dashboards.note: Proof of concept, 1 panel. Decision 2026-07-30: keep, archived.

dashboards.title: Soma OTel Local Test Proof
dashboards.note: Proof of concept, 2 panels. Decision 2026-07-30: keep, archived.

dashboards.title: Alert Groups Insights
dashboards.note: Grafana IRM. Renders empty until alerts fire and an incident process exists. Cannot be moved out of the root: Grafana rejects the write with "Cannot save provisioned dashboard".

dashboards.title: Incident Insights
dashboards.note: Grafana IRM. Renders empty until alerts fire and an incident process exists. Cannot be moved out of the root: Grafana rejects the write with "Cannot save provisioned dashboard".

dashboards.title: MacOS / logs
dashboards.note: Logs from the Angie Mac host.

dashboards.title: MacOS / overview
dashboards.note: The Angie Mac host. Its node_* series are macOS volumes, so they do not describe Supabase's disk.

dashboards.title: Metrics endpoint scrape overview
dashboards.note: Scrape health for the Supabase metrics endpoint.

dashboards.title: Supabase Project
dashboards.note: Grafana Cloud Supabase integration, 127 panels, mostly generic node_exporter series. soma-supabase covers the same ground with 29 curated panels.
